qualifier: programmed double-strand break formation, repair and resolution
name: Meiotic recombination via programmed double-strand breaks
rationale: All members cover meiotic DSB formation, DSB repair and resolution of recombination intermediates in meiosis I, unlike confusables centred on meiotic cohesion/segregation or mitotic DNA repair.

qualifier: p53 and Cdc25A degradation
name: p53 and Cdc25A degradation restraining CDK activity
rationale: Members concern ubiquitin-mediated turnover of TP53, COP1 and Cdc25A together with dephosphorylation and inhibition of CDK activity, whereas confusables emphasise p53 phosphorylation, G2/M checkpoint signaling and radiation responses.

core: Mitochondrial protein import and membrane organization
qualifier: presequence processing and degradation, cristae formation
name: Mitochondrial protein processing, degradation and membrane architecture
rationale: Members span import, signal-peptide processing and degradation of mitochondrial proteins plus cristae, outer membrane and fusion; confusables lack the processing/degradation arm (inner-membrane insertion) or the membrane-architecture arm (calcium uniporter).

qualifier: strand invasion, repair synthesis, crosslink repair
name: Homologous recombination repair of DNA breaks and crosslinks
rationale: Members centre on HR repair subpathways (SDSA, BIR, strand invasion, intermediate resolution, ICL repair) and linked checkpoints, while confusables focus on telomere maintenance, replication fork stress or the Fanconi ubiquitination arm.

qualifier: canonical destruction complex, noncanonical calcium branch and ligand secretion
name: Canonical and noncanonical Wnt signaling including ligand secretion
rationale: All members are Wnt signaling, from PORCN-dependent ligand secretion through the beta-catenin destruction complex and its cancer mutants to the Wnt/Ca2+ branch, distinguishing it from Notch/Hedgehog, Norrin-FZD4 vascular and Hippo confusables.

qualifier: capping and recombination-based maintenance
name: Telomere capping and recombination-based telomere maintenance
rationale: Members cover telomere capping, NHEJ protection, t-circle and D-loop handling and recombination/replication-based telomere maintenance, unlike confusables about replication-fork stress or telomere packaging and telomerase inhibition.

qualifier: proteasome assembly and degron-directed degradation
name: Proteasome assembly and degron-directed proteasomal degradation
rationale: Members concern proteasome assembly, N-end/C-end degron and ubiquitin-independent proteasomal catabolism (two untitled BTM modules attached), whereas confusables cover ubiquitin chain linkage/deubiquitination or misfolded-protein quality control and autophagy.

qualifier: optic nerve and retinal ganglion cell axon guidance
name: Eye morphogenesis with optic nerve and retinal axon guidance
rationale: Members are eye morphogenesis (optic cup, retina, iris, eyelid, pigmentation) plus optic nerve formation and RGC axon guidance, which the lens/cornea/photoreceptor confusables lack; the ear confusable has a different organ.

qualifier: bone marrow niche and thymic T cell development
name: Bone marrow hematopoiesis and thymic T cell development
rationale: Members regulate bone marrow hematopoiesis and lymphoid development, notably thymocyte proliferation, apoptosis and selection, which the HSC proliferation, myeloid and erythroid confusables lack.

qualifier: TLR2/4 bacterial lipid sensing and NLRP inflammasome IL-1 processing
name: TLR2/4 bacterial lipid sensing and inflammasome IL-1 processing
rationale: Members combine MyD88/IRAK4-dependent TLR2/4/5 sensing of LPS and lipopeptides with NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome IL-1 processing and inflammatory cytokine regulation, distinguishing it from TRIF, NOD1/2 and monocyte-module confusables.

qualifier: eIF3 initiation complex and start codon scanning
name: Translation initiation complex assembly and start codon scanning
rationale: All members concern formation of the eIF3-containing initiation complex and ribosomal scanning to the start codon, unlike confusables on ribosome biogenesis, termination/mRNA surveillance or 60S joining and elongation.

qualifier: HSF1 activation and attenuation
name: HSF1-mediated heat shock response activation and attenuation
rationale: All members describe regulation of the HSF1-driven heat shock response, including its activation and attenuation phases, while confusables concern senescence, UV/p53 stress or stress granules.

qualifier: skeletal dysplasia transporter and synthase defects
name: PAPS sulfate donor synthesis, transport and skeletal dysplasias
rationale: Members cover PAPS/purine bisphosphate metabolism and transport and the PAPSS2, SLC26A2 and SLC35D1 defects causing skeletal dysplasias, unlike confusables on nucleotide-sugar transport, GAG chain synthesis or selenium metabolism.

qualifier: spindle midzone and Rho GTPase-driven cytokinesis
name: Anaphase spindle midzone and Rho-driven cytokinesis
rationale: Members concern spindle elongation and midzone assembly, kinetochore attachment and Rho GTPase-driven cytokinesis, which the spindle-checkpoint and PLK1/Aurora mitotic-entry confusables lack.

qualifier: sleep/wake, stress and social behavior
name: Neuropeptide control of sleep, stress and social behavior
rationale: Members tie neuropeptide (orexin, relaxin, CRH) signaling to sleep/wake, stress, fear, mating, parental and aggressive behavior, whereas confusables focus on opioid/neuropeptide synaptic transmission or HPA hormone secretion.

qualifier: locomotor, sensorimotor and vocal/social behavior
name: Locomotor, sensorimotor and social communication behavior
rationale: Members are organismal motor, sensory and social behaviors (locomotion, reflexes, touch, prepulse inhibition, vocalization) with related brain-region development and glycinergic inhibition, unlike MECP2 transcriptional, neurotrophic or excitability confusables.

qualifier: IRF3 activation, necroptosis and HSE immunodeficiency
name: Endosomal TLR3-TRIF signaling to IRF3 and necroptosis
rationale: Members cover endosomal TLR3 trafficking, TRIF/TBK1 activation of IRF3/7, its herpes encephalitis deficiencies and RIPK/ZBP1 necroptotic cell death, which broad antiviral IFN and TRIF-IKK confusables lack.

qualifier: TLR2/4 bacterial and endogenous ligands in monocytes
name: TLR2/4 bacterial and endogenous ligand sensing in monocytes
rationale: Members cover TLR2/4/5 sensing of LPS, lipopeptides and endogenous ligands such as heme, MyD88/IRAK4 deficiencies and monocyte inflammatory modules, unlike NOD1/2, inflammasome-cytokine and myeloid-effector confusables.

qualifier: common gamma-chain, beta-common and gp130 receptors
name: Common gamma-chain, beta-common and gp130 cytokine JAK-STAT signaling
rationale: Members are IL-2/7/9, IL-3/5 and IL-6/LIF/CNTF receptor signaling via STAT5/STAT3 and ERK, distinguishing them from IL-10/12/23/27-family and EPO/FLT3 confusables.

qualifier: COPI and endosome-to-Golgi routes with lysosomal sorting
name: COPI and endosome-to-Golgi retrograde traffic with lysosomal sorting
rationale: Members cover COPI Golgi-to-ER and intra-Golgi transport, endosome-to-Golgi retrieval and Golgi-to-lysosome sorting, whereas confusables emphasise COPII ER export, Golgi organization or secretion and recycling.

qualifier: Rap1 and G12/13-Rho inputs to MAPK
name: Rap1 and G12/13-Rho signaling to integrin adhesion and MAPK
rationale: Members link Rap1, G12/13-Rho GPCR and GRB2/p130Cas-MAPK/ERK5 signaling to integrin adhesion, cytoskeletal remodeling and platelet activation, which the shear-stress, platelet-agonist and ILK/ROCK confusables lack.

qualifier: Sema3A repulsion and collateral sprouting
name: Sema3A repulsion and collateral sprouting control of axon growth
rationale: Members concern Sema3A-plexin repulsion and regulation of axon extension, branching, collateral sprouting and regeneration, unlike netrin, Sema4D/ephrin or injury-regeneration confusables.

qualifier: lipid droplet triglyceride synthesis and lipolysis
name: Lipid droplet triglyceride synthesis, storage and lipolysis
rationale: Members cover PA/DAG/TAG synthesis, lipid droplet dynamics, lipophagy and triglyceride lipolysis in adipose, distinguishing them from adipocyte differentiation/thermogenesis, glycerophospholipid remodeling and fatty acid oxidation confusables.

qualifier: protein import and very-long-chain fatty acid oxidation
name: Peroxisomal protein import and very-long-chain fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members combine peroxisomal matrix/membrane protein import and fission with acyl-CoA oxidase beta-oxidation of very-long-chain fatty acids, which the other fatty acid catabolism and pexophagy confusables lack.

qualifier: oncogenic RAS and RAF mutants
name: Oncogenic RAS and RAF mutant MEK-ERK activation
rationale: Members describe MEK/ERK activation driven by RAS, BRAF and RAF1 mutants, whereas confusables cover MRAS-SHOC2 RAF activation or ERK inactivation and negative feedback.
